page.notes: Digitiser's cover sheet of e-rara.ch (Visual Library, Universitätsbibliothek Bern), not a printed page of the book. It carries the e-rara logo, the platform descriptions in German, English, French and Italian, the terms-of-use notices and the persistent link. Per the rules it is left out. The title shown on it, "Disputatio theologica de iustificatione hominis peccatoris coram Deo", Hübner, Johann Rudolf, [Bernae], 1666, is the catalogue record of the digitised book, not text of its title page.
